content: To evaluate the impact of pre-training, we train the prediction component of CRAFT on only the labeled training data, without first pre-training the encoder layers with the unlabeled data. We find that given the relatively small size of labeled data, this baseline fails to successfully learn, and ends up performing at the level of random guessing. This result underscores the need for the pre-training step that can make use of unlabeled data.
